title: [Automatic update for 2025-12-28]
description:
Update manuf, services enterprise numbers, translations, and other items.

DMX failed.
Asterix build failed.

notes.body: Looks like failure of the DMX manfid script it not being handled correctly.

Indeed, it hits a duplicate entry 0927h there. So upstream problem, but we've to adjust...


|Hex| Organization Name | (Textual Organization Identifier)|Company	Formally Registered Y/N|

| 0926h  |   | Elumeros Lighting Limited                           | Y  |
| 0927h  |   | Guangzhou Mingying Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.  | Y  |
| 0927h  |   | Phazed Logik                                        | Y  |
| 0928h  |   | Chaostreff Backnang e.V.                            | Y  |

added 4 commits
  • 0cc0be26...9034533b - 3 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • e78e70c3 - [Automatic update for 2025-12-28]
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22965/diffs?diff_id=1611452295&start_sha=0cc0be267f859a8b4316927f3673f62afed79dc9)

I rebased with the DMX manfid fix and the Windows build is now failing with

```
FAILED suite_wslua.py::TestWslua::test_wslua_dissector_fpm - subprocess.CalledProcessError: Command '['C:\\builds\\wireshark\\wireshark\\build\\run\\Debug\\tshark.exe', '-r', 'C:\\builds\\wireshark\\wireshark\\test\\captures\\segmented_fpm.pcap', '-X', 'lua_script:C:\\builds\\wireshark\\wireshark\\test\\lua\\dissectFPM.lua', '-T', 'fields', '-e', 'frame.number', '-e', 'fpm', '-e', 'fpm.version', '-e', 'fpm.type', '-e', 'fpm.length', '-o', 'fpm.dissect_tcp:true']' returned non-zero exit status 3221225477.
```

I was able to reproduce this once locally but subsequent runs have been successful.
I'm able to reproduce this reliably with a debug build. There's no crash if I back out the introspection-enums.c changes.
This seems a consequence from moving data items from epan/ into epan/dissectors. (still not getting the rationale for this).
Okay, let this pass first, then figure out the 'introspection enums' and 'fpm test on Windows' mess.
